case_number: 2023 INSC 660; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 2207 OF 2023 [ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) No. 3433 OF 2023]
summary: Anticipatory bail denial post-charge-sheet; pre-arrest bail principles: nature/gravity of offence, witness tampering potential, flight risk; distinction between arrest power/exercise justified; Lalita Kumari mandate bypassed in FIR registration; High Court directed surrender for regular bail without addressing pending anticipatory bail; precedent reliance: Arnesh Kumar, Sushila Aggarwal; personal liberty paramount.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.498A, s.323, s.504, s.506
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.41A, s.437, s.438, s.439
final_judgment: Special leave granted; anticipatory bail granted; High Court direction to surrender for regular bail set aside.
